verdict.line: You lose lane if you stand in extended trades and let Sett bank Grit and land Facebreaker stuns; you win by poking with Q and resetting before he can cash in, which is why Riven still closes out this matchup at 51.3% over 663 games despite Sett holding the solo-kill edge.

brief.thesis: Sett's kit is built to punish standing trades: W (Haymaker) banks every point of damage he takes as Grit and pays it back as a shield plus a true-damage nuke, and his passive (Pit Grit) heals him harder the lower his health drops. Riven's Q (Broken Wings) lets her hit-and-step-back without ever letting Sett's Grit bar fill, which is exactly why OP.GG's own tip for this matchup is to poke and disengage rather than commit.

theirWindow.what: Do not let him get you between minions or walls where Facebreaker (E, CD 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, range 490) can pull you in from both sides for a stun; if his Grit bar looks full, disengage instead of trading auto-for-auto.

yourWindow.when: his E and W are both down
yourWindow.what: This is when to run the full Q-W combo: land Ki Burst (W, CD 11/10/9/8/7s) to stun, dump Broken Wings charges, and walk away before his cooldowns reset, per OP.GG's own read on this matchup.

runes.keystoneWhy: The stacking damage and healing offset Sett's Grit-based shield and passive regen across a lane defined by repeated short trades rather than one long fight.

summoners.why: The dominant pick at 94.6% and 51.4% win rate; Ignite's healing cut is what actually lets you close out kills against a champion whose passive regenerates health as he drops low.

playing.title: Poke with Q, then disengage
playing.detail: Use Broken Wings (Q, CD 13s) to hit and step out rather than committing to full auto trades; every hit you let him eat without disengaging fills his Grit bar.

playing.title: Save E for his all-in
playing.detail: Hold Valor (E, CD 10/9/8/7/6s) to block incoming damage during his all-in window rather than burning it just to gap-close.

playing.title: Track his Grit bar
playing.detail: Haymaker (W) banks the damage he takes and pays it out as a shield plus a true-damage-center, physical-damage-sides nuke; if it looks full, back off instead of trading.

playing.title: Don't get flanked for Facebreaker
playing.detail: Facebreaker (E, CD 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, range 490) only stuns if he pulls you in from both sides at once; stay on one side of him near minions so it slows you instead.

playing.title: Play around his level 6 R
playing.detail: The Show Stopper (R, CD 120/100/80/80/80s, range 400) carries and slams you, slowing everyone near the landing spot; respect it the moment he hits 6.

playing.title: Bank the full Q chain to knock him off
playing.detail: Broken Wings can be reactivated three times, with the third hit knocking back nearby enemies; save the full chain to punish him for closing distance with Q's move speed buff.

playing.title: Convert once your core is online
playing.detail: After Axiom Arc, Endless Hunger, and Death's Dance complete, look for kills whenever Conqueror is stacked and his E and W are both down, matching OP.GG's read on this matchup's win condition.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, boots, runes, and summoner spells above come from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (663 sampled for this Riven-vs-Sett matchup); the mechanical reasoning about cooldowns, trade timing, and power spikes is my own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Use your [Q] to attack and fall back periodically to prevent Sett from activating his passive ability. We recommend engaging when your Conqueror’s stacks are up and Sett’s abilities are on cooldown.
